# Reza Khosravivala

> Software engineer with a background in psychology, based in the Netherlands. This site holds his essays: a 21-part walk through Spinoza's Ethics, from the universe down to the emotions, plus pages on his work, background and contact.

Every essay has a Markdown edition at its URL plus `index.md`. The whole series in one file: https://rezakhosravi.com/llms-full.txt. Feed: https://rezakhosravi.com/feed.xml. Author page: https://rezakhosravi.com/about/.

## Essays: Spinoza's Ethics, read in order

- [1.0 Spinoza and Ethics](https://rezakhosravi.com/essays/spinoza-and-ethics/index.md): Spinoza's view on the ethics and how he proves his propositions
- [1.1 Universe](https://rezakhosravi.com/essays/universe/index.md): Cause and effect in the universe
- [1.2 Building Blocks](https://rezakhosravi.com/essays/building-blocks/index.md): Spinoza's view on the building blocks of the fundamental elements of the universe
- [1.3 God or nature (causality execution environment)](https://rezakhosravi.com/essays/god-or-nature/index.md): Spinoza's view on God, Nature, and Universe
- [1.4 Causality](https://rezakhosravi.com/essays/causality/index.md): Cause and effect, how things happen in the universe
- [1.5 Necessity or infinite accuracy](https://rezakhosravi.com/essays/necessity/index.md): How the laws of nature determine that every effect must necessarily follow from its cause
- [1.6 (perfection or reality) or (God’s perfect graphic)](https://rezakhosravi.com/essays/perfection/index.md): Spinoza view on perfection and reality and how they are synonymous
- [1.7 Miracles](https://rezakhosravi.com/essays/miracles/index.md): Spinoza's view on the miracles and the impossibility of breaking the laws of nature
- [2.0 Life or Living Beings](https://rezakhosravi.com/essays/life/index.md): Spinoza's view on the life and living beings and how they are part of nature
- [2.1 Mind](https://rezakhosravi.com/essays/mind/index.md): Spinoza's view on the mind, idea, and memory as modes of thought
- [2.2 Body](https://rezakhosravi.com/essays/body/index.md): Spinoza's view on the body and how it is a mode of substance
- [2.3 Ideas](https://rezakhosravi.com/essays/ideas/index.md): What an idea is for Spinoza: an act of the mind rather than a picture in the head, and how adequate ideas differ from inadequate ones.
- [2.4 Kinds of knowledge, reflection, mind-reality gap](https://rezakhosravi.com/essays/kinds-of-knowledge/index.md): Categorizing about all the knowledge we know therefore being able to check the validity
- [2.5 Memory](https://rezakhosravi.com/essays/memory/index.md): How memory and pattern recognition works and falsy errors
- [2.6 Mind Errors](https://rezakhosravi.com/essays/errors/index.md): Errors arise from not applying names to things rightly, and imagination does not vanish when the truth is known.
- [2.7 Freewill and Freedom](https://rezakhosravi.com/essays/free-will/index.md): In the mind there is no absolute or free will.
- [2.8 Infinite Reflection](https://rezakhosravi.com/essays/infinite-reflection/index.md): Spinoza's doctrine of infinite reflection: the idea of the mind relates to the mind as the mind relates to the body, all the way up.
- [2.9 Meaning for all beings](https://rezakhosravi.com/essays/meaning/index.md): Spinoza's view on the meaning of life and how all beings find meaning in everything
- [3.0 Emotions](https://rezakhosravi.com/essays/emotions/index.md): Spinoza's view on the emotions contrariwise
- [3.1 Emotion Definitions](https://rezakhosravi.com/essays/emotion-definitions/index.md): Spinoza's view on the emotions contrariwise
- [5.2 Intellectual Love of God or the Ultimate Freedom](https://rezakhosravi.com/essays/intellectual-love-of-god/index.md): Freedom through necessity: how understanding the causes of things, up to the third kind of knowledge, is Spinoza's ultimate freedom.
